recommendations.name: Paper texture
recommendations.why: A small press makes books, so the ground should feel like the sheet the poems are printed on: warm stock with fine fibres and tooth.

recommendations.name: Halftone
recommendations.why: Halftone dots point back to printing and zines. Kept faint in the ink colour, it suits a press that sees itself as part of a print tradition.

recommendations.name: Stippled gradients
recommendations.why: Hand-placed dots that thin out read as handmade and patient, which fits a small press's attention to the craft of the page.

contrast: #2A2420 on the plain #EFE8D9 ground comes out at about 12.5:1. The fibres are the text colour at 7% alpha, the grain shifts lightness by only ±7 levels, and the shadow wash is at most 5%. The darkest areas stay near the ground's lightness and still clear 10:1, well above WCAG AA's 4.5:1, so no scrim is needed.
